messages:
maya: Quick sync: experiments show that probe-led hedging for "low budget" tenants spikes cross-region traffic. Need a compact policy for probe quotas + backoff so deprioritization doesn't create noise.

alex: Yep. Current flow: budget_penalty -> route_score -> probes still fire if probe_delta smaller than threshold. Probes are blind to budget intent.

ben: we need a minimal surface change. proposal: introduce probe_quota and probe_backoff_ttl per tenant-region. Probes consult quota first.

sophia: agree. add graceful recovery: quota refills slowly; on repeated failures increase backoff_ttl exponentially up to cap. This prevents thrashing.

jordan: fair point about tiering. enterprise tenants should have separate, higher quotas by default. Also a global circuit-breaker if total probe_rate > cluster_probe_budget.

lee: telemetry ask: emit probe_quota_used, probe_backoff_count, probe_suppressed_reason. Dashboards + anomaly alert if suppressed probes for high-traffic tenant > 5m.

maya: DSL sketch (short):
```policy
tenant_defaults {
  probe_quota_per_min = 20
  probe_backoff_ttl = 30s
  probe_backoff_max = 30m
}
match tenant.tier == "enterprise" {
  probe_quota_per_min = 200
}
```
This keeps defaults small but configurable per-tenant.

alex: implementation note: store probe_quota state in local route-manager memory with optional persisted lease for HA. Avoid remote DB on hot path.

ben: testing plan: unit tests for quota logic, integration with probe manager sim (10k reqs), staging rollout with 1% traffic across 2 regions.

sophia: alerts: probe_suppressed_rate > 0.1% of requests for any tenant with p95_traffic > threshold -> page. Also a weekly crawler that runs full health checks ignoring quotas for reconciling silent failures.

jordan: rollback: flip a runtime flag to disable quota enforcement (fast path). Policy-manager must support schema version bump with backward-compat warn.

maya: ops-bot, can we get a changelog entry template and a canary window?

ops-bot: deploybot: Canary window recommended: 2026-04-07 02:00-06:00 UTC, start at 1% -> 5% -> 20%. Schema version increment required for probe_quota fields.

lee: one more interface boundary: policy-engine returns probe_hint { allowed: bool, remaining_quota: int, backoff_ttl: seconds } to probe-manager. Probe-manager purely enforces. That keeps scoring separate.

alex: +1. Keep probe_hint minimal and stable. No nested/ephemeral fields beyond those three.

ben: runbook note: if we see increased tail latency post-deploy, immediate action: 1) disable quota enforcement (runtime toggle) 2) revert policy config 3) run immediate full-health sweep to re-warm caches.

sophia: add metric: probe_quota_violation_attempts (should be 0 after rollout). Also instrument percent of probes that were suppressed vs fired.

maya: I'll author a follow-up RFC with: - probe_quota semantics - backoff/exponential policy - tier defaults + overrides - telemetry + alerts - API surface (probe_hint) - testing + rollout plan - rollback/runbook. Ping me for review.

ops-bot: deploybot: Reminder: update policy-manager schema docs and bump config_version when merging.

maya: thx everyone. I'll post draft in ~3h. :pray:
